reason: My register has never failed me in years, and I know every bill in it. Making 5 to 10 stylists type numbers on their phones and check in every morning, right before Puja and wedding season, sounds like more trouble and bad feeling than it is worth.
objection: The attendance check-in and the drawer-cash checks will make my staff feel I am watching them and don't trust them, and good stylists in Bhubaneswar can walk to another salon easily.
would_change_my_mind: If I could try it free for a month in a slow period, without the attendance part, and see it actually bring customers back through the WhatsApp reminders while my register stays as backup.
